ben-paran.name: Count Ben Paran of Graymere
ben-paran.description: Newly elevated count of Graymere, granted high justice and feudal rights by royal charter after saving Princess Maeryn. Arrives to a neglected county and understaffed Castle Harrowgate.
ben-paran.history:
Formerly a landless knight of the king’s guard.
Rewarded with the county after an assassination attempt on Maeryn.
Begins a steward/estate-clerk search to rebuild administration.

tomas-rell.name: Tomas Rell
tomas-rell.description: Ben’s childhood friend and practical ex-guard, accompanying him as confidant and muscle. Grounded, soldierly perspective on Harrowgate and local risks.
tomas-rell.history:
Arrived in Graymere with Ben on Day 1.
Serves as Ben’s private counsel as they assess the county.

garrick-holt.name: Garrick Holt (“Old Holt”)
garrick-holt.description: Caretaker-castellan and steward-by-necessity at Castle Harrowgate; keeper of keys and the castle’s remaining order. Central figure in the household’s survival amid unpaid wages and shortages.
garrick-holt.history:
Verified Ben’s charter and admitted him to Harrowgate.
Briefed Ben on Eastbridge governance, revenues, and peacekeeping.
Drafted a sealed letter to Asterhall seeking an estate clerk.

king-odran-iii-cauldrin.name: King Odran III Cauldrin
king-odran-iii-cauldrin.description: King of Valewyr and head of House Cauldrin, whose charter grants Ben authority in Graymere. His realm is broadly at peace and prosperous.
king-odran-iii-cauldrin.history:
Rules from Asterhall.
Sets crown obligations including annual Crown Tax expectations.

princess-maeryn-cauldrin.name: Princess Maeryn Cauldrin
princess-maeryn-cauldrin.description: Princess of Valewyr whose survival during an assassination attempt led to Ben’s elevation. A key tie binding Ben’s legitimacy to the royal house.
princess-maeryn-cauldrin.history:
Saved by Ben during an assassination attempt.
Ben was rewarded with the county of Graymere.
